C1311.title: 67 Sentenced in Ningxia Xiji Cross-Border Pig-Butchering Scam Case
C1311.summary: Ningxia Court Network reported that the Xiji County Court delivered the first-instance verdict in the '3·28' major cross-border telecom network fraud case supervised by the Ministry of Public Security, sentencing Zeng Ying and 66 other defendants for fraud, illegal border crossing, and aiding information network crimes. Zeng Ying, as the ringleader of the criminal group, was sentenced to 15 years 6 months with confiscation of all personal property. From April 2019, the group operated in Myanmar using 'pig-butchering' scams to defraud 196 victims of over 27.96 million yuan.
